method: All 39 acceptance and 33 failure-injection scenarios are enumerated from the exact accepted design authority.
Every case is bound to production owner paths and executable regressions after semantic inspection; direct ID markers are retrieval aids only.
The 11 acceptance scenarios lacking direct ID markers were manually inspected against concrete behavior rather than receiving redundant marker-only tests.
Cross-packet responsibility remains explicit; LLD-06 does not absorb Foundation transaction/job authority, Tickets Customer authority, Import source authority or Objective timezone authority.
certification_rule: All 72 LLD-06 cases are semantically bound and code-supported; CI #875 proves the cited code checkpoint and final pre-LLD-08 closure CI #946 closes R04/R05 and the accepted authority pair. Later-packet contributors and LLD-12 security composition remain outside LLD-06 certification.
known_limits: CI #875 proves the cited LLD-06 code checkpoint; final pre-LLD-08 closure CI #946 certifies the accepted authority pair after R04/R05 completion without widening later-packet ownership.
Production SQLCipher/provider composition is not proven by SQLite-backed test execution and remains later security/release composition scope.
Later-packet ReportSectionContributor implementations are outside LLD-06; LLD-06's read-only registry/validation/fail-closed consumer behavior is proven.
Marker/name presence is never treated as semantic certification.
